abstract: PURPOSE: We performed contra-lateral testicular biopsies in 55 testicular tumor patients when high orchiectomy was performed. In these cases, two cases developed invasive testicular tumor later although the biopsies had not revealed testicular CIS. Then we re-examined the sensitivity of biopsies and judged if our results are contradictory against Skakkebaek's theory. PATIENTS AND METHODS: The paraffin blocks of two cases who later developed testicular tumor were sliced again and re-examined by H/E staining and immunostaining with PLAP antibody (clone No. 8A9). The other 53 H/E samples were re-examined and the result of the contra-lateral testis was re-searched in the case that CIS was detected in the specimen. RESULTS: CIS was detected in one of the two cases who later developed contra-lateral testicular tumor and another case among the other 53 cases. We could not reveal the result of the testis of case No. 3 because of the patient's disappearance. CIS existed 3.6% (2/55) and two cases were found to have been false negative. CONCLUSION: It is important for both urologists and pathologists to know well about testicular CIS and to perform biopsy according to Skakkebaek's guidance for raising the sensitivity to detect testicular CIS.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣腫瘍患者55例で高位精巣摘除術の際に対側精巣生検を行った。このうち2例は生検で精巣上皮内癌（CIS）が認められなかったにもかかわらず、その後浸潤性精巣腫瘍を発症した。生検の感度を再検討し、結果がSkakkebaek説と矛盾するかを検討した。方法：後に浸潤性精巣腫瘍を発症した2例のパラフィンブロックを再切片化し、H&E染色およびPLAP抗体（クローン8A9）による免疫染色で再検討した。その他53例のH&E標本も再検討し、CISが検出された症例では対側精巣の所見を再検索した。結果：後に対側精巣腫瘍を発症した2例のうち1例と、その他53例のうち1例の計2例でCISが検出された。症例3は患者の消息不明のため対側精巣の結果を確認できなかった。CISは55例中2例（3.6%）に存在し、2例は初回検査で偽陰性と判定されていた。結論：泌尿器科医と病理医の双方が精巣CISについて十分に理解し、生検の感度を高めるためSkakkebaek説の指針に従って生検を行うことが重要である。
